_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Kaiba ka Player {player_id} ed sayan {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Saray rules:
- Ed say turn mo, kaiba ka balet:
  1) Makatukoy na bagong bid met a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than say current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Agcall say last bid by typing '[Call]'.

No agcall ka:
  - No say actual a count na face value among all dice et less than say bid, say last bidder matalo met one die.
  - Otherwise, say caller matalo met one die.
Say player a angga ed 0 dice et eliminated. Say last remaining player win.

board.new_round:
Bagong round - Natitira nga dice: {dice_summary}
Say tocdo yan dice mo et: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} agcall! Say actual a count na face {face_value} et {count}, a balet >= {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (say caller) matalo met one die.

action.bid_announce: Say player {player_id} so manbid na {quantity} ed lupa to {face_value}.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Say tawag et ginawa ya anggapoy akauna a bid.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action not recognized as either a valid '[Bid: X, Y]' or '[Call]'. Submitted action: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Say balon kantidad {new_quantity} et mas abeba nen say walad natan ya bilang na {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Say balon nominal a kantidad {new_face_value} et mas abeba nen say aktual ya bilang na {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Say bid et mipara ed peles ya i-bid.
bid_reason.face_range: Say nominal a kantidad et nepeg ya 1 anggad 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Say manlalaban {player_id} so naekal lapud ag-agawa.
